nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon Foreground Mark
nodes.rationale: 512x512 RGBA with a transparent field and a centered blue (#0274E0, RGB 2,116,224) mark whose alpha bounding box is roughly (127,131)-(387,371). The shape reads as a stylized upward chevron / inverted-V (peak or '∧' with a notched base), matching the Punto 'punto'/'point' identity. It is inset within the adaptive-icon safe zone so launcher masks (circle, squircle, rounded square) never crop it.

nodes.label: Adaptive Icon Layer Separation Design
nodes.rationale: Separating the icon into a full-bleed background color plate, an inset foreground mark, and a monochrome silhouette lets one brand mark adapt to arbitrary launcher masks and to Android 13+ themed icons without shipping per-shape assets. The foreground is deliberately inset to survive aggressive mask cropping.
